summary: The record_delivery action carries an asserted delivery artifact and state, and workflow.implementation and workflow.break_fix cross a gated delivery step whose single forward edge requires that record, reusing the CD-0156 single-advance-action shape. The core records the assertion and never observes GitHub, acquires no client, and runs no prober. A completed transition refuses at the gate, while cancellation and supersession stay legal and mark the item unreconciled in the workflow read projection. Live items on the gate project a parked delivery with a read-time duration, and Product rows count them as parked_deliveries, so a session that ends before the merge leaves a findable, resumable item instead of an orphaned pull request. No session waits on a merge queue.
title: Coordinator-owned delivery gate
